scope: scripts/qualify_alarm_imports.py on a frozen Debug build of 99a3709 (D:\wp\sr04), 104/104 steps, in one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1: the four alarm import kinds as in local.alarm_imports.20261028, plus plc_alarm_text_list_import: a user text list TiaMcpStates (Decimal, entries 0, 1 and 2-5) created from a workbook authored in the layout TIA V21's importer reads (importOption None), then one entry text replaced in TIA's own export with Override; each applied with checkpoint, PLC compile and save, asserted previews and change_status; every program export and member and plc_alarm_inspect's alarm classes, instance texts, supervisions, text lists and user text-list export differ in exactly the intended keys; a fresh owned Portal reopen shows the identical state; one Override from that state restored from its checkpoint equals the reopened state. Typed refusals (InvalidRequest, ArtifactChanged, InvalidArtifact, ObjectExists, PreviewMismatch, StaleRevision) change nothing.
limitations: One Decimal user text list with three entries in one culture; Binary and Bit lists, list comments, several lists per workbook, software units and HMI consumers are not exercised.

A fresh CPU has no text list to export, so the first workbook is authored (sheets TextList and TextListEntry, custom properties FileVersion 1 and FileContent 'Alarm text lists', shared strings and the styles part of a native export); the Override imports edit TIA's own export.
Engineering only; nothing is downloaded and no alarm is raised.
